caption: The drawing depicts a long, pale blue dress with long sleeves. The dress features slightly puffed shoulders, a high empire waistline, and a square neckline bordered with a small frilled trim. The sleeves are fitted at the cuffs, which also have a frilled detail. Subtle darker blue lines and shading are used to indicate folds and contours of the fabric. The hem of the dress is decorated with a wavy or scalloped trim, also in blue. In the lower left corner of the image, there is a small, simple pencil sketch of the same dress, showing its front view in basic outline. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the main focus is on the detailed watercolor rendering of the dress in the center.
